# Lucide compass — ClipCompass mark adaptation

Source: https://lucide.dev/icons/compass

SVG: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/main/icons/compass.svg

Retrieved 2026-10-28. `compass.svg` and `LICENSE` are unmodified upstream files. The license includes Lucide's ISC notice and the applicable Feather MIT notice.

`frontend/src/workspace/BrandMark.tsx` reuses the source circle and exact compass-needle path. The current 2026-10-29 adaptation uses an engraved ring, a scaled solid needle, four short ticks and one weighted quarter arc beside outlined Instrument Serif lettering. The later color-only refinement uses a blue ring, ochre needle and navy lettering without changing geometry. Previous solid discs, boxed and monochrome treatments are historical. The full lockup is 194×40px; no new icon dependency was installed. This is a local adaptation of a generic open-source symbol, not an official Miro/Kimi mark or a claim to an exclusive trademark. Lettering sources are recorded in `../instrument-serif/README.md`.
